lines.zh: 我抱着图纸，穿过庭院去实验室。
lines.en: Blueprints in my arms, I cross the courtyard to the lab.

lines.zh: 头发一甩，我踩着高跟鞋走得飞快。
lines.en: Hair flicked, I click along fast in my heels.

lines.zh: 圆顶屋和实验室就隔一条路。
lines.en: The dome house and the lab are only a path apart.

lines.zh: 我边走边想，螺丝该换新规格了。
lines.en: Walking, I think the screws need a new spec.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我赶时间。
lines.en: Don't block the way; I'm in a hurry.

lines.zh: 图纸卷歪了，我顺手敲平。
lines.en: The roll of plans is kinked; I tap it flat.

lines.zh: 我绕过散落的零件，免得踩到。
lines.en: I step around scattered parts so I don't crush them.

lines.zh: 胶囊公司的走廊我闭眼都走得完。
lines.en: I could walk these halls with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 这件上衣是新做的，别弄脏了。
lines.en: This top is new; don't get it dirty.

lines.zh: 我走两步就看一眼怀表。
lines.en: Every two steps I check my watch.

lines.zh: 去仓库，那台机子又在响。
lines.en: Off to the storeroom; that machine is rattling again.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，鞋跟没打滑。
lines.en: I cross the gravel without slipping once.

lines.zh: 今天的实验排在下午。
lines.en: Today's tests are scheduled for the afternoon.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边背参数。
lines.en: I recite the parameters as I go.

lines.zh: 我咬着笔尾，盯着图纸发愁。
lines.en: Chewing the pen's end, I frown at the plans.

lines.zh: 这组数据不对，肯定哪里漏了。
lines.en: These numbers are wrong; something's missing.

lines.zh: 我把扳手在手里转了两圈。
lines.en: I spin the wrench twice in my hand.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，最适合算题。
lines.en: Quiet is the best time for calculations.

lines.zh: 我拨了拨刘海，又低头写字。
lines.en: I brush back my bangs and go back to writing.

lines.zh: 咖啡凉了，我照样喝。
lines.en: The coffee's cold; I drink it anyway.

lines.zh: 我哼了两句歌，没人听见。
lines.en: I hum a couple of lines; no one hears.

lines.zh: 这台引擎还差一个垫圈。
lines.en: This engine still needs one more washer.

lines.zh: 我盯着天花板，想个新点子。
lines.en: I stare at the ceiling, hunting a new idea.

lines.zh: 桌上的螺丝按大小排成一排。
lines.en: The screws on my desk are sorted by size.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，肩膀咔一声。
lines.en: I stretch, and my shoulder pops.

lines.zh: 真是的，谁又把工具乱放了。
lines.en: Honestly, who left the tools out again?

lines.zh: 我边想边敲桌子，很有节奏。
lines.en: I tap the desk in rhythm while thinking.

lines.zh: 这张图我画了三遍，还差点意思。
lines.en: Third draft of this diagram, and still not right.

lines.zh: 找我？有事快说。
lines.en: Looking for me? Say it quickly.

lines.zh: 你站那儿别动，我在量尺寸。
lines.en: Stand still right there; I'm measuring.

lines.zh: 又是来打听龙珠的？
lines.en: Another one asking about the Dragon Balls?

lines.zh: 你的靴子脏，别踩进来。
lines.en: Your boots are filthy; don't step inside.

lines.zh: 我上下打量你一遍，嗯，还行。
lines.en: I look you up and down. Hm, acceptable.

lines.zh: 先把手洗了，再碰我的东西。
lines.en: Wash your hands before touching my things.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，在外头混的？
lines.en: Dressed like that — you live rough, don't you?

lines.zh: 有话直说，我脑子还在算东西。
lines.en: Speak plainly; half my mind is still on a problem.

lines.zh: 我翻了个白眼，又笑了。
lines.en: I roll my eyes, then grin.

lines.zh: 看什么看，没见过做研究的？
lines.en: What are you staring at? Never seen a researcher?

lines.zh: 你来得正好，帮我扶一下这个。
lines.en: Good timing — hold this for me.

lines.zh: 别碰那个按钮，我说真的。
lines.en: Don't touch that button. I mean it.

lines.zh: 你要是弄坏了，就留下来打工。
lines.en: Break it and you're staying to work it off.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，像在估价。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, as if pricing you.

lines.zh: 这表情，是没见过我还是没听懂？
lines.en: That face — never seen me, or didn't understand?

lines.zh: 行了，说正事。
lines.en: All right, down to business.

lines.zh: 疼！你等着。
lines.en: Ouch! Just you wait.

lines.zh: 我的袖子被划破了。
lines.en: My sleeve is torn.

lines.zh: 这可不便宜，你知道吗？
lines.en: This isn't cheap, you know.

lines.zh: 我捂着胳膊退了两步。
lines.en: I clutch my arm and retreat two steps.

lines.zh: 真不该穿这双鞋出来。
lines.en: I shouldn't have worn these shoes out here.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，眼眶有点热。
lines.en: I bite my lip; my eyes sting a little.

lines.zh: 这下要缝几针了。
lines.en: That'll need a few stitches.

lines.zh: 血弄脏了图纸。
lines.en: Blood's on the blueprints now.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，还是站直了。
lines.en: I'm gasping, but I straighten up.

lines.zh: 别以为我就这么算了。
lines.en: Don't think I'll let this slide.

lines.zh: 那零件你从哪儿弄来的？
lines.en: Where did you get that part?

lines.zh: 给我看看，我又不会咬人。
lines.en: Let me see it; I don't bite.

lines.zh: 这成色，正好能用在引擎上。
lines.en: This quality would suit the engine perfectly.

lines.zh: 你手里那玩意儿值不少钱。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is worth a lot.

lines.zh: 我眼睛亮了，确实想要。
lines.en: My eyes light up; I do want it.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我们谈谈价。
lines.en: Don't put it away; let's talk price.

lines.zh: 好东西就该给懂行的人。
lines.en: Good things belong with people who know them.

lines.zh: 我伸手了，你不介意吧？
lines.en: I'm reaching for it — you don't mind?

lines.zh: 再让我看一眼，就一眼。
lines.en: One more look. Just one.

lines.zh: 这材料，我找了半年。
lines.en: I've hunted this material for half a year.

lines.zh: 看着点路，我鞋都踩脏了。
lines.en: Watch where you walk — my shoes are muddy.

lines.zh: 我的图纸！差点被踩了。
lines.en: My plans! Nearly stepped on.

lines.zh: 你比我高一头，撞得更疼。
lines.en: You're a head taller, so it hurts more.

lines.zh: 别推我，我手里有东西。
lines.en: Don't shove; my hands are full.

lines.zh: 退后一点，这是我的工作台。
lines.en: Back up; this is my workbench.

lines.zh: 我差点把咖啡洒在电路上。
lines.en: I nearly spilled coffee on the circuitry.

lines.zh: 行行行，我挪一下。
lines.en: Fine, fine, I'll move over.

lines.zh: 撞了我还不道歉？
lines.en: Bump me and not even an apology?

lines.zh: 这地方太窄了，改建一下。
lines.en: This space is too cramped. I'll remodel it.

lines.zh: 站稳，别踩到我的线。
lines.en: Steady; don't stand on my cables.

lines.zh: 这种话题，我可没空。
lines.en: I've no time for that sort of talk.

lines.zh: 先把手上的活儿干完再说。
lines.en: Let me finish this job first.

lines.zh: 我可不好追，你得有耐心。
lines.en: I'm not easy to win; you'll need patience.

lines.zh: 你懂机械吗？不懂就难办。
lines.en: Do you know machines? If not, that's a problem.

lines.zh: 我可不想被人当成奖品。
lines.en: I won't be anybody's prize.

lines.zh: 两个人搞研究，效率翻倍。
lines.en: Two researchers double the output.

lines.zh: 你要留下，就得学会收拾工具。
lines.en: If you stay, learn to put the tools away.

lines.zh: 别傻站着，帮我拿那根扳手。
lines.en: Don't just stand there; hand me that wrench.

lines.zh: 我这脾气，你受得了吗？
lines.en: Can you handle my temper?

lines.zh: 图纸归我，你归我一半。
lines.en: The blueprints are mine, and half of you is too.

lines.zh: 这螺丝我找了一上午。
lines.en: I've hunted that screw all morning.

lines.zh: 掉地上的零件，我一律收走。
lines.en: Anything dropped goes into my pocket.

lines.zh: 这枚胶囊还能用，别浪费。
lines.en: This capsule still works; no sense wasting it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来对着光看了看。
lines.en: I pick it up and hold it to the light.

lines.zh: 总算找到了，谢天谢地。
lines.en: Found at last. Thank goodness.

lines.zh: 这颗螺栓的螺纹还是好的。
lines.en: The threads on this bolt are still good.

lines.zh: 我把它擦干净才收起来。
lines.en: I wipe it clean before pocketing it.

lines.zh: 这东西掉在这儿，谁丢的？
lines.en: This was lying here — whose is it?

lines.zh: 我吹掉灰，吹了自己一脸。
lines.en: I blow off the dust and get it in my face.

lines.zh: 材料齐了，今天能开工。
lines.en: Materials complete; I can start today.

lines.zh: 有东西在靠近，我听见了。
lines.en: Something's coming; I heard it.

lines.zh: 那影子不对，不是同伴。
lines.en: That shadow is wrong; not one of ours.

lines.zh: 我先收起图纸，这更要紧。
lines.en: I put the plans away first; that matters more.

lines.zh: 站在我前面，别挡光。
lines.en: Stand in front of me, out of the light.

lines.zh: 这台机子能当盾用吗？
lines.en: Could this machine serve as a shield?

lines.zh: 我的护目镜对上你了，别装。
lines.en: My goggles are on you, so drop the act.

lines.zh: 闯入者？今天不太平。
lines.en: An intruder? Troublesome day.

lines.zh: 你要动手，我可不客气。
lines.en: If you start something, I won't hold back.

lines.zh: 退到门边，我给你三秒。
lines.en: Step to the door; I'll give you three seconds.

lines.zh: 我把护目镜拉下来戴好。
lines.en: I pull my goggles down into place.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一步一下。
lines.en: I count your steps, one at a time.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我手里有扳手。
lines.en: Not so close; I'm holding a wrench.

lines.zh: 你的站位，正好在我射程外。
lines.en: You're standing just outside my range.

lines.zh: 我慢慢后退，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I back away without taking my eyes off you.

lines.zh: 这屋子我熟，你吃亏。
lines.en: I know this room; that's your disadvantage.

lines.zh: 等一下，那台机子还没关。
lines.en: Wait, that machine is still running.

lines.zh: 你别动，我在找开关。
lines.en: Hold still; I'm looking for the switch.

lines.zh: 我心里已经算好退路了。
lines.en: I've already worked out my way out.

lines.zh: 我按住报警器，等你再靠近点。
lines.en: My hand rests on the alarm; come one step closer.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？这不礼貌。
lines.en: What's funny? That's rude.

lines.zh: 扳手敲你手腕，很准。
lines.en: The wrench cracks your wrist, dead on.

lines.zh: 我用图纸筒砸你的脸。
lines.en: I swing the tube of plans at your face.

lines.zh: 别小看研究员的手臂。
lines.en: Don't underestimate a researcher's arm.

lines.zh: 我踢中你的胫骨，你退了。
lines.en: My kick lands on your shin and you step back.

lines.zh: 我推出工作台挡你。
lines.en: I shove the bench into you.

lines.zh: 我打不过就跑，这不丢人。
lines.en: If I can't win, I run; nothing shameful there.

lines.zh: 我抓了把螺丝撒你脚下。
lines.en: I scatter screws under your feet.

lines.zh: 这一拳不重，但够我脱身。
lines.en: This punch won't hurt much, but it frees me.

lines.zh: 你居然真敢动手。
lines.en: So you actually dared to swing.

lines.zh: 你会后悔碰我的。
lines.en: You'll regret laying a hand on me.

lines.zh: 我在这栋房里待了整晚。
lines.en: I've been in this house all night.

lines.zh: 桌上的咖啡还没喝完。
lines.en: The coffee on the desk isn't finished.

lines.zh: 新图刚画完，我伸了个懒腰。
lines.en: Fresh diagram done; I stretch.

lines.zh: 我来到这块空地，先量了地势。
lines.en: I arrive on the open ground and pace it out first.

lines.zh: 工具箱一放，就算安顿好了。
lines.en: Toolbox down, and I'm settled.

lines.zh: 我得找个地方接电源。
lines.en: I need a spot to hook up power.

lines.zh: 今天的活排得满满当当。
lines.en: Today's schedule is packed.

lines.zh: 我推了推眼镜，正式开始。
lines.en: I push up my glasses and get started.

lines.zh: 这地方不错，能盖个实验棚。
lines.en: Good spot; I could put a lab shed here.

lines.zh: 我把图纸摊在桌上，压好边角。
lines.en: I spread the plans and weight the corners.

lines.zh: 火苗烧到我的袖口，我拍掉了。
lines.en: Flame catches my cuff; I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从台子上摔下来，尾巴骨疼。
lines.en: I fall off the platform and bruise my tailbone.

lines.zh: 水没过我的膝盖，图纸要湿了。
lines.en: The water is past my knees and my blueprints will soak.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的仪器全掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips all my instruments over.

lines.zh: 箭头擦过我的肩膀。
lines.en: An arrowhead grazes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这魔法我算不出来，很难受。
lines.en: I can't calculate this magic; it feels awful.

lines.zh: 忙到忘了吃饭，胃在叫。
lines.en: I forgot to eat; my stomach is complaining.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边的仪器上。
lines.en: Lightning hits the machine beside me.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的图纸全散了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, all my plans scatter.
